description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for verifying the behavior of Git's core.hooksPath configuration variable. It sets up test hooks, checks various configurations of core.hooksPath, and verifies their effects using Git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Performs a mock commit operation within the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files or variables to expected values.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with specified content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
